name: Galba
title: Servius Galba Caesar Augustus
summary: Galba was Roman emperor, ruling for 7 months from 8 June AD 68 to 15 January 69. He was the first emperor in the Year of the Four Emperors and assumed the throne following Emperor Nero's suicide.
notes: Reign: 7 months and 7 days. Galba adopted Piso Licinianus as his successor, alienating Otho, who had expected the adoption. His murder demonstrated that emperors could be made and unmade by the army. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Galba
